clinical_summary: Stage IV NSCLC with secondary bone metastasis. First-line 1st-Gen Erlotinib failed at 14 months with acquired T790M. Liquid biopsy (ctDNA) re-evaluation now monitors emergence of tertiary C797S resistance.

genomic_mutations.target_resistance: Restores ATP affinity; resistant to 1st/2nd Gen TKIs; targeted by 3rd Gen (Osimertinib)
Abolishes covalent acrylamide Michael addition; resistant to Osimertinib
Co-alteration with RB1 wild-type; monitors against neuroendocrine SCLC lineage shift

conformational_ensembles.title: Wild-Type EGFR + Erlotinib (Active Conformation)
conformational_ensembles.significance: Demonstrates baseline ATP pocket before gatekeeper steric shift

conformational_ensembles.title: EGFR + Osimertinib (AZD9291) Covalent Adduct
conformational_ensembles.significance: Irreversible covalent bond formed with Cys797 sulfhydryl group

conformational_ensembles.title: EGFR L858R / T790M / C797S Triple Mutant
conformational_ensembles.significance: Ser797 hydroxyl replaces Cys797 thiol, abolishing covalent binding

conformational_ensembles.title: EGFR T790M + Allosteric Inhibitor EAI045
conformational_ensembles.significance: Binds αC-helix-out allosteric pocket, overcoming ATP-site resistance

candidate_compounds.name: Osimertinib (AZD9291)
candidate_compounds.mechanism: Covalent Michael addition to Cys797; highly potent against L858R/T790M

candidate_compounds.name: BLU-945 (4th-Gen TKI)
candidate_compounds.mechanism: Reversible ATP-competitive inhibition targeting triple-mutant L858R/T790M/C797S

candidate_compounds.name: EGFR PROTAC Degrader 14
candidate_compounds.mechanism: VHL/Cereblon E3 ubiquitin ligase recruitment; proteasomal degradation (DC50 = 2.9 nM)

candidate_compounds.name: EAI045 + Cetuximab (Allosteric)
candidate_compounds.mechanism: Non-ATP competitive allosteric binding at αC-helix-out pocket; requires dimerization blockade

candidate_compounds.name: Erlotinib
candidate_compounds.mechanism: Reversible ATP competitor; ineffective against restored ATP affinity of T790M

histopathology.caf_density: High (Collagen Type I crosslinking, IFP > 28 mmHg)
histopathology.til_phenotype: Immune-Excluded (sTILs trapped in peritumoral fibrotic ring)
